# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Orchestrates RED → GREEN (with retry) → REFACTOR for one feature; handles learning loop via Reflector/Curator |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles; wraps WorkerAgent + PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Standalone LLM code-generation component; builds prompts and calls LLM for each TDD phase |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer; sends code to container and returns test results |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
    Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    LLM-->>Worker: response
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    Pod->>ImportFilter: check(test_code)
    Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
    Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
    Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult
    Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
    Pod-->>Runner: red_result

    alt RED aborted (security failure)
        Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle()
        Runner-->>Runner: return CycleResult(success=False)
    else RED passed (test fails correctly)
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Runner->>Pod: run_green(retry_spec)
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: response
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>ImportFilter: check(impl_code)
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Runner: green_result
            alt GREEN passed or abort
                break
            else GREEN failed
                Note right of Runner: Set error_feedback for retry
            end
        end

        alt GREEN passed
            Runner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Runner: refactor_result

            alt Learning loop enabled
                Runner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                Reflector-->>Runner: reflector_output
                Runner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
                Curator-->>Runner: curator_output
            end

            Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle()
            Runner-->>Runner: return CycleResult(success=True)
        else GREEN failed all attempts
            Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle()
            Runner-->>Runner: return CycleResult(success=False)
        end
    end
```
